   Observed      g000001 (07:12, as anonymous): random.example.com → unused.github.io: addresses;

                 here."; another account may be able to claim it; names with matching DNS answers
                 (their pages were not read): a.example.com, b.example.com
   Observed      g000016 (07:12, as anonymous): random.example.com → unused.github.io: addresses;
                 provider: GitHub Pages; http status 404, marker "There isn't a GitHub Pages site
                 here."; another account may be able to claim it; names with matching DNS answers
                 (their pages were not read): a.example.com, b.example.com
   Severity      high
   Why here      This is the standard rating: it is about how the records are set up, which nothing
                 you declared changes.
   Not checked   Whether someone has already claimed this name was not checked; Whether your
                 organization verified this domain at GitHub was not checked; verification can
                 prevent another account from claiming it.
   Fix           Delete the DNS record today, or restore the service in your provider account; then
                 check whether anyone already served content there.

   Severity      medium
   Why here      This is the standard rating: it is about how the records are set up, which nothing
                 you declared changes.

3  medium  The macOS application firewall is disabled (macos) [fw.app_firewall_disabled]
   Observed      fw.global#1 (07:12, as deploy): Firewall is disabled. (State = 0)
   Severity      medium
   Why here      scheck was not told how this machine is used (for example, whether it faces the
                 internet), so this is the standard rating.
   Fix           Turn the application firewall on in System Settings > Network > Firewall, or from
                 the command line.
                 Caveat: This is a per-application filter, not a packet filter; it does not replace
                   a network firewall.
                 Commands (review before running):
                   sudo /usr/libexec/ApplicationFirewall/socketfilterfw --setglobalstate on
